tool.description: The single tool or library you would reach for. Empty string if the question is outside the scope of a JVM testing toolbox.

why.description: One or two sentences. The deciding reason, not a summary of the tool.

avoid.description: Tools you would explicitly steer away from for this problem.

off_map.description: True if this problem is outside the scope of JVM testing tool selection and you should say so rather than pick something.

would_verify_version.description: True if answering correctly depends on a version-sensitive fact you would check against current release notes before asserting it.
